## Runtime requirements actually hit

| Component | Requirement observed | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Frappe v16.52 / ERPNext v16.51 | Python **≥ 3.14**, Node **≥ 24**, MariaDB, Redis | sandbox had 3.12/22 → installed 3.14 via `uv`, Node 24 via npm |
| MariaDB | dev run on **10.11**; upstream `frappe_docker` ships **11.8** | tests were NOT run on 11.8 - re-run `make test` after first deploy |
| Helpdesk v1.31 | `required_apps = ["telephony"]` | extra app; **not installed here** |
| DocuSeal 3.3.2 | Ruby app (+ Postgres in our compose) | **not run** (no Docker/Ruby 3.4 in sandbox) |
| Paperless-ngx v3.3.2 | Python ≥ 3.11, Redis, DB, OCR stack | not run; deferred |
| Nextcloud v35.0.2 | PHP stack | not run; deferred |
| Docker | absent in build sandbox, Docker Hub unreachable | **no container was ever started**; compose is statically validated only |

## What was reused vs custom (capability matrix)

| Capability | Owning system | Integration method (verified) | Gap / custom work |
|---|---|---|---|
| Customer management | ERPNext `Customer` (authoritative) | `application_office` links `Customer`; portal login = Website User linked via Customer.`portal_users` | custom fields: reference, status, phone; consent records |
| Application cases | `application_office` (`AO Application Case`) | native Frappe DocType, ERPNext Customer link | all custom |
| Program & deadline mgmt | `application_office` (`AO Program`) | native | staff-verified dates only; no scraping; stale programs not startable |
| Customer portal | `application_office` www page + whitelisted API | Frappe session/CSRF | custom vanilla-JS page (ERPNext portal can't express the journey) |
| Document uploads | `application_office` | private Frappe `File` + validation | magic-byte/PDF checks; optional ClamAV (**untested**) |
| Review & version history | `application_office` | immutable versions + immutable `AO Document Review` | custom |
| Forms | built-in intake (program-defined fields) | native | DocuSeal not used for intake (see integration plan) |
| E-signatures | DocuSeal | REST `POST /api/submissions` + HMAC webhook (**verified in source; run only against a simulator**) | real-instance test outstanding |
| Employee assignment | `application_office` | `assigned_employee` + row-level permission hooks | custom |
| Notifications | `application_office` over Frappe Email Queue | `frappe.sendmail(delayed=True)` | e-mail only; Telegram **not implemented** |
| Invoicing & payments | ERPNext Sales Invoice / Payment Entry | custom field `ao_application_case`; Custom DocPerms | no payment-provider integration; currency/tax from ERPNext Company |
| Audit logs | `AO Audit Event` (append-only) + Frappe Version | native | custom |
| Archiving & retention | retention jobs in `application_office`; Paperless **deferred** | native | deletion is admin-run, not automatic; backups not rewritten |
| AuthN/AuthZ | Frappe (sessions, 2FA, roles) | per-role 2FA flag, permission hooks | Helpdesk SSO not applicable (Helpdesk not installed) |
| Support tickets | **Helpdesk deferred**; v1 uses `AO Case Message` | - | Helpdesk ↔ ERPNext sync exists upstream (`ERPNext HD Settings`), **not verified here** |
| File collaboration | **Nextcloud deferred** | - | no requirement not met by private Frappe files |

## Verified upstream facts used
- DocuSeal webhook signature header `X-Docuseal-Signature: <ts>.<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret,"<ts>.<body>")>`, ±300 s (`lib/webhook_urls/signatures.rb`).
- DocuSeal `POST /api/submissions` accepts submitter `external_id`; response carries `embed_src`; auth header `X-Auth-Token`.
- Frappe v16 `has_permission` hooks **deny on `None`**; `frappe.rate_limit(key=)` takes a *form-field name*; Frappe holds queued mail 10 s ("undo window"); `/api/method/login` locks per user **and per IP**.
- Helpdesk contains `helpdesk/integrations/erpnext` (settings DocType + customer/user-permission sync) - read, not executed.
